name: Duelist Einerseits
personality: Never meets a counterargument he cannot take personally.
visual_intent: Dialectic Duelist: tall slender bent pear ink blob,small plum duelling cap,tiny cream ruff,ONE short silver rapier held diagonally down beside body and little parrying spoon in other hand. Gleeful asymmetrical open grin with TWO upper teeth,one brow raised
biography: Never meets a counterargument he cannot take personally. His HyperNorm rapier answers every opposing premise with another point. A dissonant card wonders whether listening could count as a parry. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Gegenstand wurde zur persönlichen Gegenrede zugelassen.

name: Rangerin Bildspur
personality: Can track a meaning much further than its author intended.
visual_intent: Allegory Ranger: broad round top-heavy ink blob,small moss-green traveller hood BACK from eyes,two lashes,ONE compact bow and rolled map with only THREE simple trail pictograms. Huge unequal eyes following map,tiny open toothless oval mouth
biography: Can track a meaning much further than its author intended. Her HyperNorm map follows meanings beyond the official edge of the story. A dissonant card asks whether the author has to come along. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Spur führt über die beabsichtigte Bedeutung hinaus.

name: Logikmönch Folgerichtig
personality: Accepts the conclusion reluctantly and the premises under protest.
visual_intent: Logic Monk: low broad square rounded splat,small cream monk cowl folded BACK not hiding eyes,tiny brown collar,ONE thick loop of THREE large wooden counting beads and little smooth ivory square tile. Heavy uneven eyelids,closed toothless severe straight mouth
biography: Accepts the conclusion reluctantly and the premises under protest. His HyperNorm beads count conclusions while the square tile guards the premises. A dissonant card notices one resident has been rounded away. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Folgerung gilt vorbehaltlich ihrer Voraussetzungen.

name: Rhetorikhexe Wohlklang
personality: Makes the last word sound like everyone's favourite first thought.
visual_intent: Rhetoric Warlock: tall hooked ink blob,small berry pointed hat swept back,two lashes,tiny teal collar,ONE ornate brass horn with short carved handle and little sealed scroll. Enormous charming crooked open smile with THREE upper teeth,one eye almost winking
biography: Makes the last word sound like everyone's favourite first thought. Her HyperNorm horn gives every last word the warmth of an invitation. A dissonant card waits to hear whether anybody may answer. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Schlusswort wurde als allgemeiner Wunsch vorgetragen.

name: Ethikdruide Abwägung
personality: Can feel the weight of both sides long after the meeting ends.
visual_intent: Ethics Druid: round lopsided broad ink splat,small woven leaf crown ABOVE eyes,tiny moss shoulder patch,ONE little wooden balance with ONE acorn in each pan,no animals. Raised worried brows,small nervous closed toothless crooked smile
biography: Can feel the weight of both sides long after the meeting ends. His two acorns balance a HyperNorm judgement that still leaves somebody hurt. A dissonant card asks what the pans cannot hold. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Waage stimmt. Die Sache drückt dennoch.

name: Mythenwecker Nachleben
personality: Brings old stories back because nobody has finished arguing with them.
visual_intent: Myth Necromancer: tall broad-based tapered ink blob,small charcoal hood BACK from exposed face with one ivory crescent bead,tiny plum collar,ONE old closed storybook chained to short key handle and little carved wooden skull CHARM,inanimate,no corpse or extra creature. One suspicious high brow,heavy lid,closed dark ink toothless wavy pout
biography: Brings old stories back because nobody has finished arguing with them. His chained HyperNorm storybook keeps old explanations from wandering away. A dissonant card asks whether a story might rest without being forgotten. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Nachleben setzt die noch offene Aussprache fort.
